paths = ["data/a.txt", "data/b.txt"]

total = 0

    if len(c) > 0 and not c.endswith("\n"):
        n += 1
    out[p] = {"lines": n, "chars": len(c), "ends_with_newline": c.endswith("\n")}
    total += n
out["total"] = total
wc = env.run(["wc", "-l"] + paths, check = False)
